clauses.clause: When this enchantment enters, draw a card, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: [cast] variants: you draw Library 5#1, then 'ask one_of' over the whole hand including the drawn card; the chosen card moves hand -> graveyard (every option honoured). Also on entering during the opponent's turn. Paid {2}{U} (U-1 W-2).

clauses.clause: Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards.
clauses.evidence: 'you draw a card': ability [1] triggers, opp is targeted, opp's top two (Library 5#2, 4#2) library -> graveyard; 'you draw two cards, one after the other': two triggers, four milled (library 6 -> 2); 'the opponent draws a card -> none'; your draw step in 'turns pass' and Crash Through's draw each trigger it once; the ETB draw triggers it too. Tree identical to the compiler's parse (MOVE_ZONE 2, MILL, TOP).
